verdict.rationale: Qapita is a cap table platform, so programmatic cap table access for an agent is a fair question. The evidence only describes cap table management features and a marketing llms.txt file. It shows no API, export endpoint, agent integration, or data-room reconciliation, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
